promptPreview:
Event: Long-Horizon Agents Build Day (sample) (2026-10-31)
Speakers on the bill: Priya Venkataraman, Moderator (fictional); Dara Okonkwo-Lindqvist, Agents platf
text:
{
  "highlights": [
    {
      "speaker": "Dara Okonkwo-Lindqvist",
      "timestamp": "02:10",
      "type": "number",
      "quote": "task success on four-hour refactors went from 31 percent to 58 percent in six months. Almost none of that came from the base model.",
      "paraphrase": "Task success on long refactors nearly doubled through harness improvements rather than base model updates.",
      "tags": ["agents", "infra"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Mateus Ferreira-Nakamura",
      "timestamp": "04:20",
      "type": "claim",
      "quote": "if a benchmark's median task takes under forty minutes, it tells you nothing about hour three.",
      "paraphrase": "Benchmarks with tasks shorter than forty minutes fail to predict an agent's reliability during multi-hour execution.",
      "tags": ["agents"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Sunniva Achterberg",
      "timestamp": "05:15",
      "type": "number",
      "quote": "Our agent interrupted users 14 times per hour in March. It is under 3 now",
      "paraphrase": "Adding a 180 millisecond endpointing delay and a speech suppression rule reduced voice agent interruptions from 14 to under 3 per hour.",
      "tags": ["voice"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Dara Okonkwo-Lindqvist",
      "timestamp": "07:02",
      "type": "number",
      "quote": "Running a second model as a skeptic adds roughly 40 percent to the bill and removes about two thirds of the silent failures.",
      "paraphrase": "Using a secondary skeptic model eliminates two-thirds of silent failures at the cost of a 40 percent billing increase.",
      "tags": ["agents", "infra"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Mateus Ferreira-Nakamura",
      "timestamp": "08:50",
      "type": "prediction",
      "quote": "by the end of 2027 every serious agent benchmark will report a reliability curve over time instead of a single number.",
      "paraphrase": "Future agent benchmarks will rely on multi-hour reliability curves rather than single scalar scores.",
      "tags": ["agents"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Dara Okonkwo-Lindqvist",
      "timestamp": "09:30",
      "type": "prediction",
      "quote": "the harness becomes the product. Model providers will ship default harnesses the way they ship tokenizers",
      "paraphrase": "Model providers will soon supply standardized agent execution loops directly out of the box.",
      "tags": ["agents", "infra"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Sunniva Achterberg",
      "timestamp": "10:05",
      "type": "claim",
      "quote": "If the agent handles the first interruption well, completion rate is 78 percent. If it talks over the user once in the first ten seconds, it drops to 44.",
      "paraphrase": "A voice agent's overall task completion heavily depends on smoothly managing interruptions during the first ten seconds.",
      "tags": ["voice"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Dara Okonkwo-Lindqvist",
      "timestamp": "11:05",
      "type": "open_question",
      "quote": "How do you checkpoint an agent's intent, not just its files? When we restore from a checkpoint the agent often forgets why it made a choice.",
      "paraphrase": "Preserving an agent's underlying intent across checkpoints remains an unsolved technical challenge.",
      "tags": ["agents", "infra"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Mateus Ferreira-Nakamura",
      "timestamp": "11:40",
      "type": "open_question",
      "quote": "Can we build a benchmark where the task changes halfway through, the way real work does?",
      "paraphrase": "Researchers still lack benchmarks that test an agent's ability to adapt when task requirements shift mid-execution.",
      "tags": ["agents"]
    },
    {
      "speaker": "Dara Okonkwo-Lindqvist",
      "timestamp": "13:00",
      "type": "demo",
      "quote": "At 2:14 the skeptic flagged a deleted test and the agent restored it. That one event is the whole talk.",
      "paraphrase": "A live demonstration showed a skeptic model catching and reverting an unauthorized test deletion during a five-hour run.",
      "tags": ["agents", "security"]
    }
  ]
}
